description: This file defines the RejectionException class used in the GuzzleHttp Promise library. It represents a specialized exception thrown when a promise is rejected, encapsulating the rejection reason and customizing the exception message.

classes.name: RejectionException
classes.description: A specialized exception class for rejected promises, storing the rejection reason and generating a descriptive message.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RejectionException with the rejection reason and optional description, constructing an appropriate exception message.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for the promise rejection.
